name: @inttegro/cogni-workspace
description: Workspace for Cogni predictive loading packages

scripts.build: npm run build -w @inttegro/cogni-client && npm run build -w @inttegro/cogni-react && npm run build -w @inttegro/cogni-react-router && npm run build -w @inttegro/cogni-tanstack-router && npm run build -w @inttegro/cogni-next && npm run build -w @inttegro/cogni-astro && npm run build -w @inttegro/cogni-server
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run api:check && npm run verify:package && npm run verify:release
scripts.test: npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:integration
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:integration
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run verify:demos && npm pack --workspaces --dry-run

author: Inttegro Eng <engineering@inttegro.com>
